div.p: Start with one collector, an explicit API role, and a verified TLS connection.

Use Connections & collection to save a profile, test it, and create an input. Run each collection scope on one Enterprise heavy forwarder or search head. Configure the zabbix_index macro if the destination is not main. Search-head setup does not provision another collector.
Zabbix auditlog.get requires a Super admin token with that API method enabled. Audit logging must be enabled on the Zabbix server. Consider a separate audit profile from operational collection.

Use separate input cadences for events, inventory, and history. Scope history by item ID. Enable data-model acceleration after configuring the index macro and summary retention. Dashboards work without acceleration.

Time windows split automatically. If a single second reaches the page limit, collection reports an error and retains its checkpoint. Increase page_size or narrow scope. Delivery can replay after a crash; event_uid supports deduplication. Late updates outside the overlap need explicit backfill.

Enable LogRemoteCommands on classic agents, or Plugins.SystemRun.LogRemoteCommands on agent 2, then forward their logs. Keep agent command restrictions. To see every UserParameter/plugin child process, also collect Linux auditd or Windows process events.

Splunk encrypts API tokens through storage/passwords: new writes use $8$ on 10.6+ and $7$ on earlier versions. Existing secrets are not automatically migrated during upgrades. Never copy encrypted credentials between unrelated Splunk instances.

Start in Collector health. Check endpoint path, token role, CA bundle, certificate hostname, proxy forwarding of Authorization, and the API version. Redirects are refused. SSL verification and HTTP exceptions are explicit lab options.

API-token calls are not a complete authentication access log. Forward proxy/frontend and identity-provider logs separately. Remote command status does not establish every child process exit code. SLA collection provides definitions; it does not calculate SLI reports. See the source repository documentation for deployment examples and tested versions.
